objective: Release one verified Android staging bundle that preserves both dynamic-height Wall/Connect Notes rail and native first-view dashboard AdMob prewarming without overwriting either source.
productionBaselineEvidence: Old reviewed staging art RC 8b152c5, approved compact Notes RC a7a1eac6, and separately stage-verified ad prewarm RC aa01218a (GitHub run 43882730654). No new production OTA, DB mutation, APK or native dependency.
chosenApproach: Overlay the exact four reviewed Android prewarm source Git blobs on the verified Notes RC; force staging workflow to verify provenance and exact constrained path list before publishing.
selectionRationale: Both previous release branches target the same staging-user EAS channel; composing source is necessary to prevent last-writer-wins regression to AdMob or Wall/Connect spacing.
alternativeApproaches: Publish spacing-only OTA and silently remove prewarm (rejected: AdMob regression).
Publish ads-only and leave profile gaps (rejected: UI regression).
Push directly to production (rejected: no combined RC).
preserveBehaviors: Approved AdMob request timing, route, consent, 2-item bounded creative pool, native lifecycle and real impression rules unchanged.
Wall and Connect retain five-line Notes, 56dp avatars, dynamic 44dp min Notes rail, existing privacy and visibility.
App binary/runtime 1.3.2, artwork mapping, XP, authentication, real media, dashboard navigation and production channel unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Three required exact PR CI checks green before staging branch fast-forward.
Staging workflow verifies prior RC/Notes QA and ad source Git blobs equal approved ad staging RC, and exact path allowlist.
Android Hermes bundle + npm TypeScript and Character + compact + AdMob tests pass.
Staging-only Android OTA EAS verification confirms exact ID, package, runtime and unchanged production.
